profile.tagline: Clean gutters. Clear windows. Zero mess.
profile.description: Family-owned gutter cleaning, gutter guard installation, and window washing company serving the Raleigh-Durham area since 2014. Fully insured, background-checked crews, and a clean-up guarantee on every job.

services.name: Gutter cleaning
services.price: From $149 for single-story homes, from $219 for two-story homes
services.notes: Includes downspout flush and roof debris blow-off

services.name: Window washing (exterior)
services.notes: Pure-water system, screens and sills wiped

services.name: Gutter repair
services.notes: Reattaching, resealing, and replacing damaged sections

current_offers.name: Gutter + Window Bundle
current_offers.details: $50 off when you book gutter cleaning and exterior window washing together

current_offers.name: Senior and military discount
current_offers.details: 10% off any service for seniors (65+) and active or retired military

profile.audience: Homeowners in the Triangle area, mostly 35-70, many in two-story homes with mature trees. Busy professionals and retirees who don't want to get on a ladder.
profile.tone_of_voice: Friendly, neighborly, and practical. Light humor is fine. Confident but never pushy. Short sentences. Talks like a trusted local, not a big corporation.
